SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH period_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    FY26.period_start_date as fy26_start,
    FY26.period_end_date as fy26_end,
    FY25.period_start_date as fy25_start,
    FY25.period_end_date as fy25_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar FY26
  JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar FY25 
    ON FY26.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND FY26.fiscal_period = 4
    AND FY25.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND FY25.fiscal_period = 4
),
lfl_stores AS (
  -- Find stores open on both period start dates
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.store_name
  FROM dim_store s
  WHERE s.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web channel
    AND s.is_current = TRUE
)
SELECT 
  ls.store_id,
  ls.store_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.sale_date BETWEEN pd.fy26_start AND pd.fy26_end THEN fs.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as fy26_p04_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.sale_date BETWEEN pd.fy25_start AND pd.fy25_end THEN fs.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as fy25_p04_sales,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN fs.sale_date BETWEEN pd.fy26_start AND pd.fy26_end THEN fs.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN fs.sale_date BETWEEN pd.fy25_start AND pd.fy25_end THEN fs.net_amount ELSE 0 END)) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fs.sale_date BETWEEN pd.fy25_start AND pd.fy25_end THEN fs.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2
  ) as growth_pct
FROM lfl_stores ls
CROSS JOIN period_dates pd
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line fs ON fs.store_key IN (
  SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id = ls.store_id
)
WHERE (fs.sale_date BETWEEN pd.fy25_start AND pd.fy25_end 
    OR fs.sale_date BETWEEN pd.fy26_start AND pd.fy26_end)
GROUP BY ls.store_id, ls.store_name, pd.fy26_start, pd.fy26_end, pd.fy25_start, pd.fy25_end
ORDER BY ls.store_id

WITH period_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    'FY2026/27' as fy26_year, 4 as fy26_period,
    'FY2025/26' as fy25_year, 4 as fy25_period
),
fy26_p04_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as p04_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
),
fy25_p04_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as p04_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(a.store_id, b.store_id) as store_id,
  COALESCE(a.store_name, b.store_name) as store_name,
  COALESCE(b.p04_sales, 0) as fy25_p04_sales,
  COALESCE(a.p04_sales, 0) as fy26_p04_sales,
  ROUND(
    (COALESCE(a.p04_sales, 0) - COALESCE(b.p04_sales, 0)) /
    NULLIF(COALESCE(b.p04_sales, 0), 0) * 100, 2
  ) as growth_pct
FROM fy26_p04_sales a
FULL OUTER JOIN fy25_p04_sales b 
  ON a.store_id = b.store_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.store_id, b.store_id)

-- Calculate like-for-like growth including only stores open in both periods
WITH period_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4) as fy26_start,
    (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4) as fy26_end,
    (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 4) as fy25_start,
    (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 4) as fy25_end
),
fy26_p04_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as p04_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
),
fy25_p04_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as p04_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
),
lfl_candidates AS (
  SELECT 
    a.store_id,
    a.store_name,
    b.p04_sales as fy25_p04_sales,
    a.p04_sales as fy26_p04_sales
  FROM fy26_p04_sales a
  INNER JOIN fy25_p04_sales b 
    ON a.store_id = b.store_id
)
SELECT 
  'Like-for-Like Growth (Period 4)' as metric,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(fy26_p04_sales) - SUM(fy25_p04_sales)) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(fy25_p04_sales), 0) * 100, 2
  ) as growth_percentage,
  SUM(fy25_p04_sales) as fy25_p04_total_sales,
  SUM(fy26_p04_sales) as fy26_p04_total_sales,
  COUNT(*) as stores_counted
FROM lfl_candidates

-- Like-for-like growth by region
WITH fy26_p04_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    ds.region,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as p04_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region
),
fy25_p04_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    ds.store_name,
    ds.region,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as p04_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region
),
lfl_by_region AS (
  SELECT 
    a.region,
    b.p04_sales as fy25_p04_sales,
    a.p04_sales as fy26_p04_sales
  FROM fy26_p04_sales a
  INNER JOIN fy25_p04_sales b 
    ON a.store_id = b.store_id
)
SELECT 
  region,
  ROUND(SUM(fy25_p04_sales), 2) as fy25_p04_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(fy26_p04_sales), 2) as fy26_p04_sales,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(fy26_p04_sales) - SUM(fy25_p04_sales)) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(fy25_p04_sales), 0) * 100, 2
  ) as growth_percentage,
  COUNT(*) as store_count
FROM lfl_by_region
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

WITH fy26_p04_sales AS (

fy25_p04_sales AS (

-- Check for stores that have sales in one period but not the other
WITH fy26_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
),
fy25_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(a.store_id, b.store_id)) as total_stores,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.store_id) as stores_with_fy26_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.store_id) as stores_with_fy25_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.store_id IS NOT NULL AND b.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN a.store_id END) as lfl_stores
FROM fy26_stores a
FULL OUTER JOIN fy25_stores b ON a.store_id = b.store_id

-- Like-for-like growth for period 4: FY2026/27 vs FY2025/26
WITH fy26_p04 AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.store_id
),
fy25_p04 AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.store_id,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) as sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
  WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
    AND ds.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY ds.store_id
),
lfl AS (
  SELECT 
    b.sales as fy25_sales,
    a.sales as fy26_sales
  FROM fy26_p04 a
  INNER JOIN fy25_p04 b ON a.store_id = b.store_id
)
SELECT 
  'FY2026/27' as fiscal_year,
  4 as period,
  ROUND(SUM(fy25_sales), 2) as fy25_p04_net_sales_eur,
  ROUND(SUM(fy26_sales), 2) as fy26_p04_net_sales_eur,
  ROUND((SUM(fy26_sales) - SUM(fy25_sales)) / NULLIF(SUM(fy25_sales), 0) * 100, 2) as like_for_like_growth_pct
FROM lfl
